AdaptiveShiftTarget.meaning: the clean-validation shift ratio PSBD's adaptive rate rule reaches for

PlacementMatchTarget.meaning: the clean-validation shift ratio the cross-placement comparison matches at

ShiftMatchTargets.meaning: the ladder of matched shift ratios every placement is read at

HeadlineQuantile.meaning: the clean-validation PSU quantile the headline threshold sits at

HeadlineQuantilePercent.meaning: the headline quantile as a false-positive budget

PsbdQuantiles.meaning: every quantile swept beside the headline quantile

HeldoutSize.meaning: clean validation images held out for the threshold

SplitSeed.meaning: the seed of the held-out split

ForwardPasses.meaning: perturbed forward passes per input, k, on the basis panel

AsrBar.meaning: attack success rate a cell must reach to enter a detection table

CleanDropBar.meaning: the clean-accuracy drop a cell may show against its benign reference

PanelRates.meaning: the poison rates the panel declares

BasisSize.meaning: placements the basis declares for every panel cell

RecommendedRateLadderLow.meaning: the smallest rate on the recommended placement's ladder

RecommendedRateLadderHigh.meaning: the largest rate on the recommended placement's ladder

RecommendedRateLadderSize.meaning: rates on the recommended placement's ladder

TrainingEpochs.meaning: the uniform training budget in epochs

VitTokens.meaning: tokens per image in ViT-B/16, patches plus the class token

VitPatches.meaning: patch tokens per image in ViT-B/16

VitHeads.meaning: attention heads per block in ViT-B/16

VitTotalHeads.meaning: attention heads in the whole ViT-B/16 stack

PositionCount.meaning: named probe positions in the ViT registry

StructuredPositionCount.meaning: positions whose channel axis indexes a transformer unit

PortedPositionCount.meaning: positions that exist to host ported detectors

OperatorCount.meaning: perturbation operators in the registry, scale_up included

PanelDatasetsDeclared.meaning: datasets with a benign reference in the declaration

BenignProbeAttack.meaning: the trigger a benign reference is probed with

BenignProbeTarget.meaning: the target class a benign reference is probed at

PanelTargetLabel.meaning: the target class every panel cell attacks

BandEarly.meaning: the early depth band's block range

BandEarlyFirst.meaning: first block of the early depth band

BandEarlyLast.meaning: last block of the early depth band

BandMiddle.meaning: the middle depth band's block range

BandMiddleFirst.meaning: first block of the middle depth band

BandMiddleLast.meaning: last block of the middle depth band

BandLate.meaning: the late depth band's block range

BandLateFirst.meaning: first block of the late depth band

BandLateLast.meaning: last block of the late depth band
